reasons: Cited §8.2 text matches the preferred position: successive twelve-month (not multi-year) renewals, Customer opt-out on thirty days' written notice (≤30-day window), and a Vendor reminder at least sixty days before renewal — with the opt-out deadline extended if the reminder is missed, which is strictly better for us.
Cited §8.3 satisfies the price-predictability element: uplift capped at the lesser of CPI and three percent, ninety days' notice of increases, and no increase on prepaid periods.
Deterministic check confirms the computed notice window (30 days) is within the preferred threshold; no walk-away trigger (no >90-day window, no multi-year auto-renewal) is present.
Rationale correctly distinguishes §8.1's three-year master term from a renewal term, so it does not undermine the compliant call.

Consistent with a compliant finding, the redline is identical to the original paragraphs and no counterparty comment was raised — appropriate to retain as internal evidence rather than a negotiation issue.
